title: checkout third column in this command
description: swetest -p0123456789 -b10.07.2026 -fldtz -g, -- in rust, print --ZD--; should print values
root_cause: The 'z' format specifier (zenith distance) set needs.equatorial but not needs.azalt. The xaz data it reads was only populated by the azalt block, which forces TOPOCTR and fails without a configured topographic position. C's swetest computes zenith distance from the plain (non-TOPOCTR) equatorial position via swe_azalt — a coordinate transform, not a parallax correction.
